messages:
sam: Morning folks, Sam here  starting as Product Designer. Quick check: I can't open the Product Roadmap page in Notion (403), the Figma plugin 'TokenSync' isn't available in our org, and I don't know the research payment flow for panels. Who should I ping for each?

ellie: welcome @sam :wave: I'm design-ops. Notion 403 usually means your SSO group hasn't synced; I can escalate to IT. For the TokenSync plugin we whitelist it per-team  I'll check permissions and either enable it or share a local Tokens file. Research payments are handled by research ops (cc @morgan).

raj: hi @sam, congrats! Roadmap is at Notion > Product > Quarterly Roadmap. I can paste the current quarter summary in the thread if you need immediate context while we fix access. Also the weekly product design critique is Wed 9:30am PST  I'll add you once Notion is sorted.

sam: Thanks. A short paste of the roadmap summary would be great. Also curious if we track accessibility requirements in PRDs or a separate checklist.

ellie: Roadmap TL;DR: Q2 focus  latency optimization (infra), new routing policies (platform), and UX investment in onboarding flows (product). Design tasks linked to onboarding are in the "Onboarding epic" page. Accessibility: we keep an a11y checklist as part of the PRD template in Notion > Product > Templates. If you can't access Notion, I can DM a copy of the checklist.

morgan: research-ops chiming in: payments for study participants go through Research Payments form (Drive > UX > Forms). For small stipends (<$100) we use prepaid cards; for larger panels we do vendor invoices. Fill the form and include estimated headcount & stipend amount; ops issues the funds. If you're recruiting external participants, legal review is required for messaging.

sam: appreciate that. I just tried the TokenSync plugin in Figma and it says "Plugin not available for org". If you can whitelist or share tokens file that would unblock me. Also, can someone add a short note about where to find prior research summaries (for context)?

ellie: re TokenSync: requesting whitelist now (ticket IT-7741). Meanwhile I'm attaching a zipped tokens export to your email and will drop a link in DMs. Prior research summaries live in Notion research index and Drive > UX > Summaries. Morgan, is there a preferred short path we can paste here for Sam to use?

morgan: paste path for starters: Drive > UX > Summaries > Executive_Summaries (and Notion > Research > Index). If Notion is blocked, the Drive folder has PDFs we mirror there. Also, @recruiting-bot will create a payment request stub if you DM it the study name and stipend.

recruiting-bot: :money_with_wings: Payment request template created: PR-8892. Reply with: study_name, stipend_per_participant, expected_count, and requester_email to start issuance.

sam: Helpful, thanks. One last thing  is there a recommended onboarding read for product context (customers, telemetry dashboards, OKRs) so I can come into my 1:1 prepared?

raj: Read: 1) Notion > Product > "Customer Signals" 2) Telemetry dashboards (Looker link in Product Playbooks) 3) Last quarter's OKRs under Product > OKRs. I'll DM you direct links and add a 30-min context sync before your 1:1.

ellie: IT updated: Notion group sync ticket submitted, ETA EOD. TokenSync whitelist requested. I uploaded tokens to Drive and sent the link to your mail. I'll add you to the Wed critique once Notion access is confirmed. Welcome aboard again!

sam: Fantastic, thanks everyone. I'll DM the recruiting-bot the study stub later and will look for your DMs, @raj and @ellie. Appreciate the fast responses :heart:
